body:
Phase 3 (T-161). Design: "Settling up" in the spec. The Android twin of the web
ticket: BalancesScreen gains "Settle up" with the same rows, the same empty and
solo behaviour, and Record under the same four conditions, opening ExpenseDialog
pre-filled through ExpenseFormViewModel.

Five strings in all nine locales (French apostrophes escaped). Tests as for web,
in the view-model test class that has MainDispatcherRule, not the Compose one.
title: expenses: Android — settle-up section and record
